attempts.summary: Published node1’s approved release tree as the persistent, read-only rsync module `releases`. Node2 retrieved it to `/srv/rsync-releases-mirror` with file modes and symlinks intact. Write, sibling-module, and traversal attempts are denied. Both nodes were restarted individually and fully recovered without changing AlmaLinux 9.6 or kernel 5.14.0-570.12.1.el9_6.
